interpretation.core_meaning: A conjunction brings two symbolic functions into the same field, intensifying their combined expression and making them difficult to separate in experience.
possible_expressions: Experiencing two needs as one concentrated impulse
Giving unusual focus to the life areas represented by both functions
Finding that one function strongly colors how the other is expressed
interpretation.developmental_direction: Learn to recognize both functions inside the combined impulse so that neither is unconsciously overshadowed by the other.

interpretation.core_meaning: A sextile describes compatible symbolic functions that can open useful opportunities when they are consciously engaged rather than simply assumed to work on their own.
possible_expressions: Finding practical ways for two different strengths to cooperate
Recognizing an opening that becomes useful through participation
Developing a capacity by moving between curiosity and action
interpretation.developmental_direction: Actively use the available cooperation between both functions instead of waiting for its possibilities to develop automatically.

interpretation.core_meaning: A square describes friction between symbolic functions whose competing demands create pressure for action, adjustment, and a more capable way of holding both.
possible_expressions: Feeling pushed to respond when two needs demand different actions
Repeating a friction until a more workable response is developed
Turning internal pressure into effort, skill, or decisive change
interpretation.developmental_direction: Use the friction as information and motivation, making room for both functions without treating either one as the problem to eliminate.

interpretation.core_meaning: A trine describes an easy flow between symbolic functions, often experienced as a familiar resource or ability that requires little internal negotiation.
possible_expressions: Drawing naturally on two strengths at the same time
Experiencing a capacity as familiar or readily available
Overlooking an ability because it operates with little friction
interpretation.developmental_direction: Use the available ease deliberately so that a natural resource becomes an active contribution rather than an unexamined comfort zone.

interpretation.core_meaning: An opposition places two symbolic functions across a polarity, increasing awareness through contrast and often inviting balance between alternating or projected positions.
possible_expressions: Alternating between two needs that initially feel incompatible
Meeting one side of an inner polarity through another person
Developing perspective by recognizing value at both ends of a tension
interpretation.developmental_direction: Build a conscious relationship between both sides of the polarity instead of identifying with one and locating the other entirely outside oneself.
